headline: Money Flows Back to Banks, Will Interest Rate Pressure Ease?
summary: Money flowing back into Vietnamese banks is easing liquidity tensions. Interest rate pressure remains high due to large capital demand in the economy and flexible monetary policy.
why: Bank liquidity and interbank rates shape lending costs and profitability for listed Vietnamese banks. Monetary policy determines the direction of these rates.
